attributes.name: CEE1 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Community Identification
attributes.proposal:
Identify how the climate adaptation plan describes the process for identifying Environmental Justice (EJ) and 
equity-deserving populations.

attributes.name: CEE2 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Community Identification
attributes.proposal: According to the climate adaptation plan, were community-based organizations (CBOs) and civil society organizations (CSOs)  involved in the identification of communities at risk, the development of the adaptation plan, its implementation, and the evaluation of its effectiveness?

attributes.name: CEE3 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Community Identification
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan detail the extent to which Environmental Justice (EJ) and equity-deserving populations 
(including low-income, people of color, rural communities, people with disabilities, elderly, youth, Indigenous peoples, LGBTQIA+)  were involved in all stages of the policy design and implementation process?

attributes.name: CEE4 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan include an analysis of how the adverse impacts of climate change are distributed across 
different communities?

attributes.name: CEE5 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan identify specific populations that are considered to be more vulnerable to the impacts of climate change?

attributes.name: CEE6 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan identify specific populations that are likely to experience a greater magnitude of climate change impacts?

attributes.name: CEE7 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan identify specific populations that are likely to experience a greater frequency of climate change impacts?

attributes.name: CEE8 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan acknowledge that certain populations may face multiple, overlapping climate change 
impacts?

attributes.name: CEE9 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan compare the distribution of climate change impacts with indicators of socioeconomic vulnerability?  Indicators of vulnerability include: age, low income, disability, chronic illness, non-native English speakers, immigration status, etc.?

attributes.name: CEE10 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan describe whether impacted communities were involved in the process of identifying and 
analyzing climate change impacts?

attributes.name: CEE11 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan state that the impact analysis incorporates community-generated data, traditional 
ecological knowledge, stories, and lived experiences alongside technical models and projections?

attributes.name: CEE12 - Identifying and Understanding Impacts Upon Communities - Distributional Impact Analysis
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan address the risk of climate gentrification and the potential for increased housing costs in 
vulnerable communities?

attributes.name: CEE13 - Participation - Barriers
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan describe efforts made to remove barriers to community participation, such as providing  translation, accessible meeting locations and times, childcare, etc.?

attributes.name: CEE14 - Participation - Communication
attributes.proposal: What types of information about climate change were provided to community members, and in what formats, according to the climate adaptation plan?

attributes.name: CEE15 - Participation - Communication
attributes.proposal: Were trusted members of the impacted communities involved in the communication efforts related to the climate adaptation plan, as described in the plan?

attributes.name: CEE16 - Participation - Continuing Engagement
attributes.proposal: What measures are outlined in the climate adaptation plan to empower communities to sustain adaptation efforts over the long -term?

attributes.name: CEE17 - Participation - Continuing Engagement
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan specify how progress will be reported back to communities in transparent and accessible ways to encourage ongoing participation?

attributes.name: CEE18 - Participation - Continuing Engagement
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan outline a process for course correction if evidence suggests unintended inequitable pathways or outcomes are emerging?

attributes.name: CEE19 - Participation - Continuing Engagement
attributes.proposal: How does the climate adaptation plan involve communities in ongoing monitoring, evaluation, and accountability measures related to the adaptation efforts?

attributes.name: CEE20 - Solutions - Prioritization
attributes.proposal: For each major proposed adaptation measure in the climate adaptation plan, is an assessment of the distribution of benefits and costs considered?

attributes.name: CEE21 - Solutions - Prioritization
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan state that adaptation measures are prioritized taking into account the burdens and 
vulnerabilities of Environmental Justice (EJ) communities and equity-deserving populations?

attributes.name: CEE22 - Solutions - Prioritization
attributes.proposal:
What specific indicators are tracked to measure equity outcomes in the climate adaptation plan (e.g., reductions in 
heat-related illness, displacement rates, access to green space, continuity of utility services, access to continuity of transporation services, community satisfaction and trust)?

attributes.name: CEE23 - Solutions - Prioritization
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan define what successful adaptation would look like from the perspective of Environmental Justice (EJ) and equity-deserving communities?

attributes.name: CEE24 - Solutions - Prioritization
attributes.proposal: How does the climate adaptation plan consider Indigenous rights and cultures in adaptation priorities?

attributes.name: CEE25 - Solutions - Specific Considerations
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan include anti-displacement tools, such as tenant protections, affordable housing 
initiatives, or community land trusts, as a measure to mitigate the risk of climate gentrification?

attributes.name: CEE26 - Solutions - Resources
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan address distributive equity by specifying a percentage of climate adaptation resources to be dedicated to disadvantaged communities?

attributes.name: CEE27 - Solutions - Resources
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan outline the creation or expansion of programs to provide technical assistance to local municipalities and tribal communities for their own climate adaptation planning?

attributes.name: CEE28 - Solutions - Resources
attributes.proposal:
How do the funding criteria and scoring systems for climate adaptation projects in the plan reward, penalize, or inhibit 
projects that primarily serve Environmental Justice (EJ) and equity-deserving communities?

attributes.name: CEE29 - Solutions - Resources
attributes.proposal:
Are there dedicated funding streams within the climate adaptation plan specifically for EJ-led, Indigenous-led, or 
community-based projects, in addition to large-scale infrastructure projects led by state agencies?

attributes.name: CEE30 - Solutions - Resources
attributes.proposal: Is a defined share of adaptation funds for participatory budgeting or other resident-led allocation processes?

attributes.name: CEE31 - Governance - Decentralization
attributes.proposal:
Does the climate adaptation plan allocate a defined share of adaptation funds for participatory budgeting or other 
resident-led allocation processes?

attributes.name: CEE34 - Governance - Decentralization
attributes.proposal: Does the climate adaptation plan provide information that enables local municipalities and tribal communities to assess  their own climate and social vulnerability?

attributes.name: CEE35 - Governance - Structure
attributes.proposal: Do relevant governance structures (boards, advisory councils, community oversight committees) outlined in the climate adaptation plan include representatives from Environmental Justice (EJ) and equity-deserving communities with real authority over priorities, budgets, and trade-offs?

attributes.name: CEE36 - Governance - Redress & Accountability
attributes.proposal:
What mechanisms are in place within the climate adaptation plan to allow communities to challenge decisions, file 
complaints, or seek remedies if adaptation projects cause harm?
